messages:
Emma (Marketing): Heads-up team 1: we need final links and benchmark wording for the release post. Target publish T-24h. Sam, can you confirm changelog availability and whether we'll have a stable public docs URL? :calendar:
Sam (Engineering): Changelog PR is open (#904). Perf run still baking; expecting signal in ~4h. If green, I can merge and trigger the release pipeline.
Priya (Product): We prefer a non-PR docs link for the announcement. Suggest path /docs/releases/2026-03-performance. Can DevEx stage that path?
Jorge (DevEx): I'll build and stage the docs at that path now. Starting static build + CDN invalidation.
deploy-bot: deploy job started to staging - job id: doc-deploy-2143. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/2143
Jorge (DevEx): Staging deploy complete . Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-performance. Note this is behind the staging CDN, we'll flip to prod once you say go.
Emma (Marketing): Great. For the benchmark blurb, Sam suggested "~2x throughput improvement on common text-generation workloads". Keep it conservative and link to benchmark notes. Sam, what public-safe link will we point to for bench results?
Sam (Engineering): We'll sanitize the internal report and publish a public summary at https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03. I'll post the sanitized link here before EOD. Recommend Marketing reference the harness rather than raw internal numbers.
Priya (Product): Webinar planning: schedule for Apr 9. Marketing to collect registrants; HubSpot should tag leads with "launch-2026-03" and add them to nurture "launch-bench-webinar". Jorge, can you wire a registration webhook to tag and route leads?
Jorge (DevEx): Yes. I'll create an automation that only tags contacts from the webinar landing page. Example webhook logic (pseudo): ```bash
POST /hubspot/contacts?tag=launch-2026-03&list=launch-bench-webinar
```
Jorge (DevEx): Implemented filter by landing_page_id so only webinar signups get the tag. Also added a retry on 5xx responses.
Emma (Marketing): Checklist: 1) Merge changelog PR 2) Prod docs URL live 3) Public bench link posted here 4) Launch post scheduled + social copy 5) HubSpot webhook/tag active. React when done. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Engineering): Merged PR #904 and kicked release pipeline (1719997200). :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: docs prod deploy started - job id: doc-deploy-2144.
Jorge (DevEx): Prod docs published at https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-performance. CDN edge propagation ~5m. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Engineering): Public benchmark summary sanitized and published: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-summary. Wording approved: "~2x throughput improvement on typical LLM text-gen workloads (see benchmark notes)."
Priya (Product): I updated the Notion draft with the final docs and bench URLs and scheduled the webinar. Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/p/launch-2026-03.
Emma (Marketing): All set on our side. I'll schedule the post for T-24h and prep social. HubSpot webhook test passed and tags applied correctly. Thanks everyone 44AA
Jorge (DevEx): Quick note: CDN purge caught a missing image reference in the docs. Fixed and re-pushed at 1719997000.
Sam (Engineering): Thanks. Closing loop 1: public links above are the ones to use in the announcement.
Emma (Marketing): Perfect. If anything regresses, please ping this thread immediately.
